module_summary: 10G PHY bit-error-rate monitor counting invalid sync headers per 125us window and flagging high BER when 16 errors occur.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr
anchors.why: Received sync header checked against SYNC_CTRL/SYNC_DATA to detect errors.

anchors.name: rx_high_ber
anchors.why: High BER indication output, copy of rx_high_ber_reg.

anchors.name: time_count_reg
anchors.why: 125us window timer; expiry resets error count and clears flag.

anchors.name: ber_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts invalid headers in window; reaching 15 sets high BER.

groups.name: ber_monitor
groups.description: Window timer and error counter deciding the high BER flag.
